h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, ג׳ Acharei Mos, 3
The Double Song of Shabbos Unites the Two Torahs

p: בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג נו, ב)
In the holy Zohar (this parshah, III 56b):
A song that is doubled, etc.,
and so 'A psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos.'"
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (שׁוֹחֵר טוֹב, תְּהִלִּים צב, א)
And so wrote the Midrash (Shocher Tov, Tehillim 92:1):
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּתִּיקּוּנִים (תִּיקּוּן יג)
according to what is written in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 13):
and this is the right arm," etc.
And so wrote the holy Zohar
That is, Chochmah is the Written Torah,
וְעַתָּה כִּתְבוּ לָכֶם אֶת הַשִּׁירָה וְגוֹ׳
"And now write for yourselves this song," etc.;
that it is a mitzvah to write a Sefer Torah.
which is called "a Torah of kindness,"
"and a Torah of kindness is on her tongue";
and "Torah in order to teach it,
this is a Torah of kindness"
which is for teaching to students.
And so Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
to discover the Torah on his own,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה סא, א)
and he had no teacher, etc.;
אֶלָּא זִימֵּן לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
rather the Holy One, blessed be He, provided him
His Godliness, blessed be His Name,
to all who come into the world;
and this is a Torah of kindness,
that they were accustomed to study the mishnayos
from the expression "to cut down all the tyrants";
it helps to cut down the tyrants,
And so wrote (the Ra'aya Mehemna, Pinchas, there):
from the side of the song of Torah
even if he does not know what he is saying,
for it helps to cut off and to prune
all the thorns and the briars
And this is what it said,
for Shabbos is the attribute of Malchus,
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרֵינַן לָהּ
"the mouth, we call it Torah she'b'al peh";
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
and so wrote the holy Zohar (I 47b):
the Torah was given on Shabbos."
וּכְתִיב טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת לַה׳ (תְּהִלִּים צב, ב)
And it is written, "It is good to give thanks to Hashem" (Tehillim 92:2):
that is, to rectify the past,
as written in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer,
'One who confesses and forsakes shall be shown mercy.'"
And Shabbos helps to rectify the past,
that even one who worships idols like Enosh
"And to sing to Your Name, Most High":
which on Shabbos is revealed to Yisrael,
it helps to cut down those that surround,
which is the attribute of Malchus;
which is not so with the sons of Korach,
who came to rectify the blemish of their father,
"For the entire congregation, all of them are holy,
that Torah she'b'al peh is not needed,
which is the power of Aharon,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (שְׁמוֹת ד, טז; ז, א)
shall be a mouth for you";
שֶׁאֵין צָרִיךְ כְּלָל לְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
that there is no need at all for Torah she'b'al peh,
just as it will be in the future,
since their words are written in the Torah,
it is not a fabricated thing;
for even though they said this,
as explained in the Midrash (Tanchuma, Parshas Toldos)
since it is written in the Torah,
that in truth the entire congregation,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כג, יג)
to sanctify him as holy of holies," etc.
And about this Moshe Rabbeinu said,
makes himself as one who is nothing,
he merits to be a chariot
which is called holy of holies,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קכא, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (II 121a):
"'And wisdom, from where is it found?'
The Torah came forth from wisdom,
from the place called the Holy of Holies";
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב)
came to rectify the blemish of their father;
therefore they said "a song, a psalm":
for even though it is true
that the entire congregation, all of them are holy,
and Torah learning was implanted in their hearts,
the Written Torah, which is called "shir";
and to this only Aharon merited,
who is a chariot for the attribute of Ayin
and was set apart to be holy of holies;
